description: Unofficial WhatsApp desktop linked-device client built with Tauri and whatsmeow.
notes: The upstream describes this unofficial client as private-testing software, not a production-ready WhatsApp Desktop replacement.
Agent Control is experimental and can give allowlisted chats full local command execution with network access and no approval prompts. Keep it disabled unless you fully trust those chats.
Linked-device credentials and profile data remain under %LOCALAPPDATA%\rust-meow after Scoop uninstall.
